import.consent: Client details will be imported exactly as entered. By choosing to import them, you confirm they have agreed to receive messages (SMS or email) from your business that Innoweb may send on your behalf.

upload.dropHint: Drag and drop your file here
upload.noFile: Don't have a file? Fill our template with your client information and upload.
upload.ready: File is ready for column matching.

mapping.title: Review column matching
mapping.subtitle: Make sure the columns in your file are matched correctly to the columns in the Innoweb client list
mapping.firstNameRequired: Match First name to a column in your file to continue

fieldHelp.firstName: First name of your client. Required for import.
fieldHelp.phone: Mobile phone number of your client. Please include the country code.
fieldHelp.gender: Gender of your client. Accepted values: M, F, Male, Female, Non binary, Prefer not to say.
fieldHelp.birthday: Birthday of your client. Format YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY.
fieldHelp.emailMarketing: Whether the client consents to email marketing. Accepted values: Yes, No.
fieldHelp.smsMarketing: Whether the client consents to SMS marketing. Accepted values: Yes, No.
fieldHelp.whatsappMarketing: Whether the client consents to WhatsApp marketing. Accepted values: Yes, No.
fieldHelp.emailNotifications: Whether the client wants to receive email notifications. Accepted values: Yes, No.
fieldHelp.smsNotifications: Whether the client wants to receive SMS notifications. Accepted values: Yes, No.
fieldHelp.whatsappNotifications: Whether the client wants to receive WhatsApp notifications. Accepted values: Yes, No.
fieldHelp.staffAlert: This staff alert will appear on the client's profile and appointments.
fieldHelp.tags: Tags assigned to the client. Separate multiple tags with a pipe (|).

preview.emptyBody: It looks like no data was found in this tab

loyalty.title: Turn all clients into regulars
loyalty.body: Watch your sales skyrocket with a custom loyalty program - encouraging repeat visits and larger purchases.
loyalty.bullet1: Offer the ultimate loyalty experience with points, tiers and referrals
loyalty.bullet2: Reward your clients with exclusive offers, discounts and incentives to celebrate their loyalty
loyalty.bullet3: Allow clients to easily track their progress and redeem rewards online
loyalty.activeBody: Clients earn points on every visit and can redeem rewards online and in-store.

reputation.title: Online reputation
reputation.subtitle: Manage reviews across Innoweb and Google in one place.
reputation.tip: Explore Innoweb's powerful tools to get client reviews that grow your business. Watch the handy video guides now.
reputation.googleLinkBody: View and manage your Google reviews in one place
reputation.disconnectBody: Google reviews will no longer show here. You can connect again at any time.

connectModal.title: Your Google reputation, managed – right where you run your business
connectModal.body: Connect your Google Business Profile to manage reviews alongside your Innoweb feedback – no more switching between tabs. We'll pull in your full review history and keep everything in sync.
connectModal.b1: View, filter and reply to Google reviews directly from Innoweb
connectModal.b2: Get instant alerts for reviews so you can respond before they impact your rating
connectModal.b3: Fully automated – set it up once and keep the reviews and replies always in sync
connectModal.accountBody: Choose the Google account that manages your Business Profile.
connectModal.locationsBody: Match each of your locations with its Google Business Profile.

reputation.emptyBody: Prompt clients to leave Innoweb reviews after each visit — just check out appointments and keep your thank-you automations on. You can also keep your reviews coming from Google, just link your account now.
reputation.noMatchBody: Try a different period, location or filter.
reputation.replyPlaceholder: Write a public reply to this review
reputation.deleteReplyBody: The reply will be removed from this review.

player.line1: Reviews are the first thing new clients look at before they book.
player.line2: Every checked-out appointment sends a thank-you message with a review link.
player.line3: Reply to every review – clients notice, and so does your rating.
player.line4: Link Google to see all of your reviews in one place.
